howto.what: Claude 会帮你用 pytest 写和调试 Temporal 工作流测试：单元测试用时间跳跃把长流程压缩到秒级跑完，集成测试里 mock activity，回放测试用生产历史验证确定性，并按需读取分场景的资源文件。
howto.when: 当你为 Temporal 工作流编写测试、排查测试失败，或搭建本地 Temporal 开发环境时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude writes and debugs pytest tests for Temporal workflows: unit tests use time-skipping for fast runs, integration tests mock activities, and replay tests check determinism. It loads a per-scenario resource file on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write or debug tests for Temporal workflows, or set up a local Temporal dev environment.
